jobs.title: SVP, Information Technology
jobs.description:
**We Create Products and Brands That People Trust to Clean, Sanitize, and Protect Their Homes and Pools**
When you join KIK Consumer Products, you’re joining a team that cares about the work we do and also about each other. We bring exceptional brands and products to consumers that help them protect the health and wellness of their families and the cleanliness of their homes and pools. We are committed to building a culture of performance driven by accountability, collaboration, and agility that enables timely fact\-based decision\-making and exceptional execution with unwavering ethics. As one of North America’s largest independent manufacturers of consumer products, KIK helps a large portfolio of brands and retailers bring their products to life. **Your Role at KIK**
The Senior Vice President of Information Technology will set and execute KIK's enterprise technology strategy, enabling business growth, manufacturing performance, operational excellence, and measurable value creation. This executive will lead IT operations, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, data and analytics, AI and automation, and technology supporting KIK's manufacturing network.

  

Partnering closely with executive leadership, the VP will translate business priorities into a practical multi\-year technology roadmap, modernize and simplify the technology environment, strengthen security and resilience, and build a high\-performing IT organization grounded in accountability, transparency, collaboration, and business partnership. **What You’ll Do*** Set and deliver a multi\-year enterprise technology and investment roadmap aligned with business and operational priorities
* Partner with executive and operational leaders to prioritize technology investments and translate them into measurable business outcomes
* Lead reliable, secure technology across corporate offices, manufacturing sites, warehouses, and distribution centers
* Advance IT/OT integration, plant connectivity, automation, analytics, and digital manufacturing capabilities
* Lead ERP, enterprise applications, data, architecture, integrations, and modernization initiatives, including SAP/S/4HANA where applicable
* Own cybersecurity, technology risk, disaster recovery, and business continuity across IT and OT environments
* Strengthen cloud, infrastructure, networks, end\-user technology, and service delivery through clear performance measures and service levels
* Lead technology governance, budgeting, vendor management, sourcing decisions, and value realization
* Build and develop a high\-performing IT organization and strategic partner network.
* Communicate technology priorities, performance, risks, and investment needs with executive leadership and the Board, as appropriate
* Support technology due diligence and integrations or separations for acquisitions, divestitures, and restructuring as needed
* Develop, coach, and retain a high\-performing IT leadership team, building the capabilities, accountability, and succession needed to support the organization’s strategic objectives.
* Serve as a strategic business partner to executive and functional leaders, aligning technology priorities and investments with business goals, operational needs, and growth initiatives.
* Lead the evaluation, implementation, and scaling of AI\-enabled solutions that improve productivity, decision\-making, operational performance, and employee or customer experience.
* Partner cross\-functionally to identify high\-value AI use cases, establish appropriate governance and adoption plans, and lead change management efforts to ensure successful implementation.
* Partner with business and commercial leaders to co\-lead the development and execution of eCommerce capabilities, ensuring technology solutions support digital growth, customer experience, and evolving business needs

 **What You’ll Bring*** Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline required; advanced degree preferred
* 15\+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including significant senior leadership responsibility in a complex enterprise environment
* Experience leading technology in multi\-site manufacturing, industrial, consumer products, chemical, or similarly complex operations strongly preferred
* Demonstrated success developing and executing enterprise IT strategies and multi\-year roadmaps tied to business and financial outcomes
* Significant ERP and enterprise applications experience; major ERP transformation, upgrade, or implementation experience strongly preferred; SAP/S/4HANA experience is highly relevant
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing technology and IT/OT environments, cybersecurity, infrastructure/cloud, data and analytics, AI/automation, and business continuity
* Experience managing significant budgets, vendors, sourcing models, and enterprise\-wide transformation in fast\-paced environments
* Executive\-level communication, critical thinking, analytical capability, and the ability to build trust and influence across all levels of the organization

 **What You Will Get**
KIK offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits including health, wellness, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. You can plan for your future with KIK's retirement savings options including employer match. KIK also recognizes the importance of continuing education and offers Education Assistance to our employees to encourage continued personal development and growth.  

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. This position has a base salary range of $275,000\-325,000 plus eligibility for an annual incentive bonus. The actual salary may vary based upon several factors including your relevant skills and experience. **About KIK**

jobs.title: Managing Director, Head of Financial Engineering
jobs.description:
Application Deadline:


12/04/2026
Address:


100 King Street West
Job Family Group:


Data Analytics \& Reporting
The Head of Financial Engineering is responsible for establishing and leading the Financial Engineering function across Global Asset Management.  



  

This leader will partner with investment, risk, client, operations and technology stakeholders to identify, prioritize, design and deliver advanced analytical tools, data solutions and decision\-support capabilities that enhance investment outcomes, business effectiveness and client value.  



  

The role combines deep technical expertise with strategic leadership, ensuring that analytics and technology investments are aligned to business priorities and delivered through scalable, sustainable solutions.


The incumbent will lead a team of quantitative, analytics and engineering professionals while acting as a senior advisor to business leaders on data, analytics, investment technology and innovation opportunities.  



  

**What Success Looks Like**

Three years from now this leader has:


* Built a recognized Financial Engineering function.
* Established a clear intake and prioritization model.
* Delivered investment analytics and portfolio intelligence capabilities.
* Improved the speed and quality of business decision making.
* Created stronger alignment between Investment teams, Technology and Data organizations.
Established a team capable of delivering sophisticated analytics solutions at scale.  
* 

  

**Core Accountabilities**

**Financial Engineering Strategy**

* Define the vision, operating model and roadmap for Financial Engineering across GAM.
* Develop a multi\-year strategy for analytics, investment tooling and decision\-support capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to leverage data, quantitative methods, automation and emerging technologies to solve investment and business challenges.
Evaluate external trends and industry practices to identify competitive advantages.  
* 

  

**Business Partnership**

* Serve as a strategic advisor to senior business leaders.
* Partner with Portfolio Managers, Research teams, Product leaders, Distribution leaders and operational partners to understand strategic priorities.
* Translate business opportunities into technology, data and analytics solutions.
Establish governance frameworks for intake, prioritization and delivery.  
* 

  

**Analytics and Solution Development**

* Lead the design and delivery of portfolio analytics, risk analytics, attribution, performance measurement and decision\-support tools.
* Oversee development of advanced analytical frameworks and data products.
* Guide evaluation and implementation of quantitative methodologies and emerging technologies.
Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable and aligned to enterprise architecture standards.  
* 

  

**Portfolio Leadership**

* Lead a portfolio of strategic initiatives from concept through implementation.
* Establish delivery roadmaps and execution plans.
* Balance competing priorities across stakeholder groups.
* Manage dependencies across business, data and technology teams.
Ensure realization of expected business outcomes.  
* 

  

**People Leadership**

* Build and lead a high\-performing Financial Engineering team.
* Recruit, develop and retain quantitative, engineering and analytics talent.
* Provide technical direction and coaching.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability and continuous improvement.
Establish standards, practices and methodologies for solution development.  
* 

  

**Enterprise Influence**

* Develop trusted relationships with executives across GAM and enterprise partners.
* Lead discussions involving complex technical and business concepts.
* Influence investment and technology strategies through data\-driven recommendations.
Represent GAM within enterprise analytics, technology and innovation forums.  
* 

  

**Ideal Experience Profile**

**Experience**

* 12\-15\+ years of progressive experience within Asset Management, Wealth Management, Capital Markets or Financial Services.
* Experience leading analytics, quantitative, investment technology or financial engineering functions.
* Proven track record delivering enterprise\-scale data, analytics or technology capabilities.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Experience leading large transformation programs and strategic initiatives.
Extensive stakeholder management experience with executive leadership teams.  
* 

  

**Technical Expertise**

Strong understanding of:


* Portfolio construction
* Investment analytics
* Performance attribution
* Risk analytics
* Market and security data
* Data architecture
* Cloud\-based analytics environments
* AI and machine learning applications
Software development lifecycle and product delivery methodologies  
* 

  

**Leadership Capabilities**

* Strategic thinking
* Executive presence
* Enterprise influence
* Organizational leadership
* Program governance
* Change leadership
* Decision making under ambiguity
* Complex stakeholder management

**Salary** **:**

$120,000\.00 \- $215,000\.00
**Pay Type:**

Salaried
The above represents BMO Financial Group’s pay range and type.


Salaries will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role, and may include a commission structure. Salaries for part\-time roles will be pro\-rated based on number of hours regularly worked. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.


BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance\-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. BMO also offers health insurance, tuition reimbursement, accident and life insurance, and retirement savings plans. To view more details of our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.bmo.com/global/

jobs.title: Director, Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**Location:**

243 Consumers Road, Toronto, Ontario, M2J 4W8
At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk\-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.  

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

**Why this role is important?**

**Position Overview**
---------------------


Reporting to the SVP, Pharmacy, the Director, Strategy \& Operations is a strategic partner to the Pharmacy Operations \& Transformation leadership team, responsible for driving strategic planning, operational excellence, business transformation, and execution of enterprise and divisional priorities.


The Director translates complex business priorities into actionable plans, executive insights, and measurable outcomes. Key accountabilities include coordinating the Multi\-Year Plan (MYP), Current Year Plan (CYP), leading cross\-functional initiatives, and developing high\-quality Board of Directors and executive leadership materials.


The role also champions artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and digital solutions to improve productivity, streamline processes, and enhance decision\-making. Success requires strong strategic thinking, executive communication, analytical capabilities, and hands\-on execution.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Strategic Leadership \& Executive Partnership**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to the SVP and leadership team, providing strategic insights, business recommendations, and execution support.
* Lead coordination of MYP, CYP, strategic reviews, and business planning processes.
* Align cross\-functional priorities, accountabilities, milestones, and measurable outcomes across Pharmacy and enterprise partners.
* Anticipate business challenges, identify opportunities, and support executive decision\-making.

### **Board \& Executive Communications**

* Lead development of Board, Board Committee, Executive Leadership Team, and senior management presentations, briefing materials, and strategic reports.
* Translate complex financial, operational, and strategic information into compelling, concise, data\-driven narratives and actionable recommendations.
* Manage executive reporting processes, coordinating stakeholder inputs, timelines, quality assurance, and final deliverables.
* Anticipate leadership questions and ensure materials demonstrate accuracy, strategic alignment, and executive\-level quality.

### **Strategic Initiatives \& Transformation**

* Lead complex, cross\-functional strategic initiatives and transformation programs from planning through implementation and value realization.
* Establish project governance, workplans, milestones, accountabilities, risk mitigation, and performance reporting.
* Facilitate executive steering committees, strategic workshops, and decision\-making forums.
* Drive change management, process redesign, implementation, and benefits realization across Pharmacy, Shoppers Drug Mart, and Loblaw Companies Limited.

### **AI, Technology \& Automation**

* Champion responsible adoption of generative AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve productivity, efficiency, and business performance.
* Identify and implement AI\-enabled solutions for research, analysis, reporting, presentations, workflow management, and executive decision support.
* Partner with IT, Digital, Data \& Analytics, and business teams to prioritize and deliver automation and digital transformation opportunities.
* Promote AI literacy, innovation, and continuous improvement while ensuring alignment with enterprise security, privacy, and governance standards.

### **Operational Excellence \& Business Insights**

* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and optimize business processes, operating models, and workflows.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives delivering measurable productivity gains, operational efficiencies, and cost savings.
* Develop KPIs, dashboards, business cases, and performance reporting to support strategic decisions and track results.
* Conduct business analysis, scenario planning, and opportunity assessments, translating insights into actionable recommendations.

### **Leadership, Collaboration \& Governance**

* Build strong relationships across Pharmacy, Shoppers Drug Mart, Loblaw, and enterprise functions, driving alignment and accountability.
* Influence cross\-functional teams and stakeholders to deliver shared objectives in a matrixed organization.
* Coordinate executive meetings, strategic planning sessions, leadership communications, and governance forums.
* Maintain confidentiality, sound judgment, and operational discipline while championing innovation and results\-oriented execution.

**Skills, Experience \& Education**
-----------------------------------

### **Strategic \& Business Capabilities**

* Strong background in strategic planning, business transformation, operational excellence, and complex program execution.
* Broad understanding of pharmacy operations, healthcare, retail, and enterprise business strategy.
* Strong business acumen, financial literacy, analytical thinking, and structured problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated ability to advise senior executives, manage competing priorities, and translate strategy into execution.

### **Executive Communication \& Leadership**

* Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, including experience developing Board and C\-suite materials.
* Advanced PowerPoint capabilities, executive storytelling, and ability to synthesize complex information into clear, decision\-oriented recommendations.
* Strong executive presence,

jobs.description:
**Join a Challenger**  

  

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.  

  

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.  

  

**What's kept us moving?** The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.  

  

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.  

  

We can’t wait to get to know you!

 ***The Work***

This role is responsible for overseeing the delivery of cyber security outcomes and driving enterprise\-wide changes in meeting the Organization’s cyber security strategic objectives. This role is responsible for planning, overseeing and organizing resources required to achieve the corporate cyber objectives. This role facilitates the governance, monitoring, communication/escalation and presentation of cyber security roadmap.
### **The Core Responsibilities!**



* Facilitate and support the strategic planning processes for identifying priorities for the cyber security program and articulating the strategy and roadmap.
* Develop budget and financial planning documents and facilitate approvals.
* Oversee assignment of delivery leads or project managers and ensure proper project governance to realize outcomes.
* Financial planning, forecasting and budgeting for the cyber security program.
* Monitor the cyber program execution and delivery.
* Drive complicated and enterprise\-wide initiatives with cyber security impact for the organization and provide Executive reporting.
* Collaborate and negotiate with technology and business leaders to gain support for initiatives and resource needs for program success.
* Ensuring program delivery success by addressing challenges to success and promptly escalating as required.
* Provides leadership and coaching for delivery leads and project managers in gap areas such as financial planning, change management or as required to achieve needed outcomes.
* Measure, monitor and report on benefit realization
### **Let's Talk About You!**



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in IT/Cyber, with at least 5 years in leading enterprise programs.
* Proven track record in leading cyber transformation or digital modernization programs.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, cloud platforms, and security frameworks.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, or TOGAF are a plus.
* Good understanding of accounting and financial management
* Good understanding of benefit realization measurements techniques.
* People \& resource management
* Strategy and Financial Planning
* Process \& capability Management
* Technology Roadmaps
* Ownership \& Accountability

  


**Communication Skills:**



* Good documentation skills
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Good interpersonal skills, with proven track record of developing relationships and communicating conceptual information effectively to individuals unfamiliar with subject material.
* Strong organizational skills: demonstrated ability to manage time and adhere to tight deadlines.
* Confident, personable, credible professional presence.

\\uD83C\\uDFDD Generous vacation policy and personal days

\\uD83C\\uDF93 Professional development and comprehensive Career Development program
\\uD83D\\uDC9B A fulfilling opportunity to join one of the top FinTechs and help create a new kind of banking experience

The incumbent will be working hybrid and in office time will be spent working from EQ Bank’s additional office space located at **2200\-25 Ontario Street, Toronto, ON**.  

  

**Equity, Diversity \& Inclusion**



EQ is committed to building an inclusive, accessible environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and supported. We believe our organization is stronger — and our people thrive — when we honour and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives. We’re equally committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally.



We provide a barrier‑free recruitment process and work environment. If you require accommodations at any stage, we will work with you to ensure you can bring your best self to the process and beyond.



As part of our recruitment process, EQ uses AI to help screen, assess, and/or select applicants for this position. All AI\-enabled outputs are reviewed and validated by our talent team. All candidates considered for hire must successfully complete a criminal background check and credit check. While we appreciate every application, an EQ recruiter will contact only those whose skills and experience most closely match the requirements of the role.

jobs.title: Practice Director - Sales (ERP)
jobs.description:
Being a Practice Director \- Sales at Innovair Solutions means leveraging your strong leadership, strategic mindset, and ability to bring teams together around a shared vision.


As a Practice Director \- Sales, you will be responsible for guiding business decisions related to Sales and Customer Service processes as part of our ERP transformation. You will play a key role in harmonizing business practices, optimizing processes, and supporting the adoption of solutions that drive organizational growth and efficiency.

**What your day\-to\-day will look like:*** Develop a comprehensive understanding of business activities, process architecture, and the future objectives of the functional area.
* Define guiding principles, priorities, and expected outcomes for Sales and Customer Service processes.
* Resolve conflicting needs across business units, teams, and processes while making clear and timely decisions.
* Validate major operational changes, deviations from standard processes, and proposed trade\-offs.
* Work closely with the Core Team Analyst to maintain a decision\-making pace aligned with project timelines.
* Mobilize managers, subject matter experts, and end users around agreed\-upon business directions.
* Champion decisions and support change management efforts through adoption.
* Ensure the selected solution supports both current operations and medium\- and long\-term business objectives.
* Participate in design workshops, decision reviews, and sessions requiring business arbitration.
* Review options, impacts, risks, and dependencies prepared by the Core Team.
* Consult stakeholders when required and make decisions within project timelines.
* Communicate business directions and explain the rationale behind decisions.
* Support critical Go\-Live activities and escalations impacting the functional area.
  

  

  

**You are the person we are looking for if you have:*** A university degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* The ability to distinguish between local preferences, business requirements, and regulatory or operational obligations.
* A strong understanding of integrated Order\-to\-Cash processes, including order management, pricing, fulfillment, invoicing, returns, and after\-sales service.
* A solid understanding of the interdependencies between Sales, Customer Service, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Operations.
* The ability to translate business needs into clear functional requirements and assess their compatibility with standard ERP capabilities.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills in a complex environment with competing priorities.
* A demonstrated ability to influence managers and stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills with operational, technical, and executive audiences.
* A strong orientation toward standardization, continuous improvement, and end\-to\-end process optimization.
* The ability to work effectively in a demanding project environment, meet tight deadlines, and make decisions with incomplete information.
* A minimum of 7 to 10 years of relevant experience in Sales, Customer Service, business process transformation, or ERP implementation.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Experience engaging stakeholders, communicating business direction, and supporting change management through adoption.
* Experience participating in an ERP deployment, including design workshops, testing, operational readiness, go\-live activities, and post\-implementation stabilization.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365\), considered an asset.
* The ability to communicate in both French and English, verbally and in writing, to meet the requirements of the role and interact with various stakeholders.

**How this job stands out from the rest:*** Work from home up to 3 days per week.
* Flexible schedule.
* Comprehensive group insurance plan with employer contributions starting on your first day.
* Retirement savings program with employer contributions from day one.

  

Message from the Recruiters  

  

We can’t wait to meet you!  

  

Because we’re passionate about people, we’re eager to learn about your aspirations and see how your potential can flourish with us.  

  

Want to learn more about the opportunities that could be waiting for you? We’re looking forward to your application!  

  

About us  

  

Supported by a vast North American distribution network and more than 1,200 dedicated employees, our group stands out as a major player in the heating, air conditioning, and ventilation sectors. Recognized among the Best Managed Companies, our businesses leverage the complementarity of their expertise to drive innovation and build a sustainable future.
  

  

Our company is deeply committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and strives to provide a respectful and welcoming work environment for everyone. Believing that talent comes in many forms, we encourage all motivated individuals to apply—even if they don’t meet every single requirement.  

  

The masculine gender is used without discrimination and solely for the purpose of making the text easier to read.
